info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Card By Param1-spec
info.description: The Card Management API allows for the dynamic update of card information associated with a specific network participant facility using a unique identifier (param1). This operation is essential for maintaining accurate and timely data across banking systems, facilitating seamless transactions and compliance. Typical consumers include financial institutions and banking applications that require real-time modifications to card attributes. With this API, clients can efficiently manage card lifecycle changes without disrupting user experiences.

patch.summary: Update a card network participant's facility details.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific card network participant facility identified by CARD-400045. Ensure to provide the necessary fields to be updated in the request body.
